text:
maria: Heads up — pushing Mixtral-7B onboarding bundle to staging. Profiling shows p95 tail latency spike when seq >= 1024. @sam any idea?

sam: saw similar on my run. Batcher thrashes around 1024-2048. KV cache misses go up. Might be RoPE scaling mismatch after conversion :thinking:

kai: can you paste the perf log snippet?

maria: 
```
perf: requests/sec=820 p50=18ms p95=242ms p99=410ms seq=2048
kernel_picker: selected generic_rope_kernel_v2 (fallback)\nkv_cache: misses=38/1000\nbatcher: avg_batch=4.1 queues=8
```

perf-bot: nightly-profiling: kernel selection fell back due to 'rotary_dim' mismatch. Fallback kernel has worse latency at long seq. See /opt/profiler/logs/218765

lee: I suspect hf parser is dropping 'rotary_scaling' from hf_config in some safetensors -> pt conversion. Our conversion script strips metadata when heads != kv_dim. Safetensors metadata check needed.

sam: repro steps: 
```
# reproduce
python tools/serve_local.py --model mixtral-7b-staging --seq 2048 --batch 8
# observe kv cache rebuilds and increased p95
```
Parsing output: rotary_scaling: null -> runtime uses default 1.0 -> RoPE scaled incorrectly

maria: plan: (1) add a lint in conversion to preserve rotary_scaling and n_heads, (2) add onboarding sanity check to fail if safetensors missing required metadata, (3) tweak batcher heuristic to cap queue growth while kernel fallback occurs.

sam: I have a small patch for parser: preserve 'rotary_scaling' at tools/convert/safetensors_to_hf.py line ~312. I'll open PR `eng/runtime/mixtral/rotary-preserve`

perf-bot: quick bench on sam's branch: p95 reduced from 242ms -> 199ms at seq=2048 (18% improvement). Kernel picker now prefers optimized_rope_kernel if rotary_scaling present.

maria: nice. I'll deploy the patch to staging and run a 1% canary on dedicated pool. If green, we'll roll to prod tomorrow. Thanks!

kai: add a note in onboarding doc about 'rotary_scaling' and safetensors metadata checks.

lee: ACK — will update docs.

maria: tagging this thread for postmortem root cause: conversion -> missing rotary_scaling -> kernel fallback -> batcher thrash -> tail latency. Will attach perf graphs.
